subject: math.DS
name: Birkhoff billiard conjecture
statement: Must a smooth strictly convex planar billiard whose phase space has a full neighborhood of the boundary foliated by invariant caustics be an ellipse?
importance: It predicts that integrability rigidly determines the shape of a billiard table.
status_note: Local results near ellipses and results under stronger integrability assumptions are known; the general smooth conjecture remains open.

references.title: On the Local Birkhoff Conjecture for Convex Billiards

subject: math.DS
name: Palis density conjecture for smooth surface dynamics
statement: For every integer r at least two, can every C^r diffeomorphism of a compact surface be approximated in the C^r topology either by a hyperbolic diffeomorphism or by one with a homoclinic tangency?
importance: It proposes a universal description of the mechanisms obstructing hyperbolic behavior.
status_note: The corresponding C^1 surface result is known; the higher-regularity approximation problem remains open. Hyperbolic means Axiom A with no cycles.

references.title: Homoclinic tangencies and hyperbolicity for surface diffeomorphisms

subject: math.DS
name: Positive metric entropy for the standard map
statement: Does there exist a parameter K for which the area-preserving standard map y′ = y + K sin(x), x′ = x + y′ modulo 2π has positive metric entropy with respect to Lebesgue measure on the two-torus?
importance: It would rigorously establish widespread chaotic behavior in a canonical Hamiltonian model.
status_note: Positive topological entropy and many hyperbolic sets are known; they do not imply positive entropy for the ambient invariant area measure.

subject: math.DS
name: Furstenberg’s ×2–×3 measure-rigidity conjecture
statement: Is every nonatomic Borel probability measure on R/Z that is invariant and ergodic under the semigroup generated by x ↦ 2x and x ↦ 3x equal to Lebesgue measure?
importance: It asks whether two multiplicatively independent expanding symmetries force complete measure rigidity.
status_note: The positive-entropy case is proved; the possible zero-entropy nonatomic measures remain the unresolved case.

references.title: Furstenberg’s Times 2, Times 3 Conjecture (a Short Survey)

subject: math.DS
name: Sarnak’s Möbius disjointness conjecture
statement: For every continuous map T on a compact metric space with zero topological entropy, every continuous function f, and every point x, does N^−1 sum from n=1 to N of μ(n) f(T^n x) tend to zero?
importance: It predicts that arithmetic randomness is orthogonal to all deterministic systems of zero entropy.
status_note: The assertion is known for many dynamical classes; zero topological entropy alone remains insufficient for a general proof.

subject: math.DS
name: Shub’s entropy conjecture for C^1 diffeomorphisms
statement: For every C^1 diffeomorphism f of a closed smooth manifold, is its topological entropy at least log of the spectral radius of the induced map on total real homology?
importance: It would link observable dynamical complexity to the algebraic growth of topology.
status_note: The C^∞ case follows from Yomdin’s theory, and C^1 diffeomorphisms away from homoclinic tangencies are understood. This formulation excludes noninvertible C^1 maps, for which a 2026 counterexample has been reported.

references.title: The Entropy Conjecture for Diffeomorphisms away from Tangencies

subject: math.DS
name: Katok’s entropy-rigidity conjecture
statement: If a closed negatively curved Riemannian manifold has geodesic-flow entropy with respect to normalized Liouville measure equal to its topological entropy, must its metric be locally symmetric?
importance: It asks whether equality between average and maximal dynamical complexity characterizes symmetric geometry.
status_note: The surface case is known; the conjecture in higher dimensions remains open without additional assumptions.

references.title: Katok’s entropy conjecture near real and complex hyperbolic metrics

subject: math.DS
name: Local connectivity of the Mandelbrot set
statement: Is the Mandelbrot set locally connected at every point?
importance: It would provide a precise combinatorial model for the parameter space of quadratic complex dynamics.
status_note: Local connectivity is proved at many parameters; arbitrary infinitely renormalizable parameters are not all covered.

subject: math.DS
name: Collatz conjecture
statement: Does repeated application of n ↦ n/2 for even positive integers and n ↦ 3n+1 for odd positive integers eventually reach 1 from every starting positive integer?
importance: It exposes how little is understood about the global behavior of a very simple discrete dynamical system.
status_note: Extensive computation and results for almost all orbits do not prove termination for every positive integer.

subject: math.DS
name: Chowla’s two-point correlation conjecture
statement: Does N^−1 sum from n=1 to N of λ(n)λ(n+1) tend to zero, where λ is the Liouville function?
importance: This basic correlation question is central to the dynamical interpretation of multiplicative-function randomness.
status_note: Logarithmically averaged versions and various averaged-shift statements are known; this ordinary Cesàro average remains open.

references.title: The logarithmically averaged Chowla and Elliott conjectures for two-point correlations
